prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 poster for an adult neighborhood rubber-block printing and shared short-reading evening, shown on community and cultural-center digital screens. This is the complete poster itself, no surrounding room, border mockup, contact sheet, panels or alternatives. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole visual design: saturated contemporary social illustration with clean angular carved/engraved contours. Pale lilac ground, a broad burnt-orange elliptical tabletop viewed obliquely from overhead, indigo adults and contours, a pale warm central sheet. Adult cultural-event tone: companionable, active, welcoming to beginners; mature faces, economical shapes, no cute mascots, toy objects or antique paper simulation. Carved nonletter ink cuts belong to the people, table and print; letter strokes stay pristine and crisp.

Compose directly for the wide frame. Use a 720×405 design coordinate guide scaled to the native canvas: quiet fact ledges above y=125 and below y=340; the main ellipse and social scene span about x=61–667, y=130–329. The central light sheet occupies about x=256–520, y=178–296 and has horizontal unwarped title baselines starting near x=279,y=192. It is a real single shared paper lying on the table, not a separate typographic sign floating over the scene. Its title is the visual centre.

Two adult readers with visible eyes, mouths and shoulders enter the table scene from above and from the right. Adult heads about 65–75 pixels at this guide size; both look towards the title on the shared sheet, and one mouth is open mid-reading. Show heads in an oblique view that retains facial features. Indigo hair and clothing, pale lilac face planes, angular expressive engraving cuts. Keep all upper and lower practical facts fully unobstructed by the figures.
A third adult's continuing forearm enters the table from the lower left. Its distinct clean-edged fingers grasp the side of a thick carved rubber printing slab, lifting it just above the LEFT part of this same light sheet. Show the slab thickness, inked carved underside, and a clear lifting gap. Beside it on the same sheet, show a fresh corresponding 55–65 px nonletter indigo impression: a compact branching-leaf design with angular cut marks, visibly the same pattern as the rubber underside. The impression lies to the right of the title without touching the letters. There are only the TWO adult readers and this third printing forearm; no extra heads, loose disembodied hands, books, invented page writing, speech bubbles or unrelated tools. Rubber, transferred print and shared title-bearing paper must be visibly connected. Preserve a broad ellipse rather than a frontal tall page.

Typography and copy placement: print the following ELEVEN entries exactly once each. Preserve Korean spelling, word spaces, all digits, the ampersand, middle dots, commas, colons and the en dash. These are the only words anywhere. No extra labels, logo, watermark, QR, pseudo-writing or decorative glyphs. At the 720px guide, practical information must remain comfortably readable; high-contrast dark indigo on the unobstructed pale lilac ledges. Use clean regular Korean sans for facts, open sans for activity, tabular economical numerals, extended light English capitals, and a clear square literary Korean serif only for the paper title.

Central shared-paper title, square Korean serif about 33 px with a 39 px line step, left aligned, break after the first word into TWO lines:
인쇄하고 읽는 밤

Upper-right event identification starts x=392,y=28, two rows with about 26 px step, English about 19 px and activity about 18 px:
PRINT & READ
고무판 인쇄 · 짧은 낭독

Upper-left complete attendance anchor starts x=28,y=23, four left-aligned rows, each 24–26 px high; sizes about 20,23,18,17 px respectively. Date, time, venue and entry remain one retrievable group:
2026.12.12 토요일
18:00–20:30
망원 생활문화센터
17:40부터 입장

Lower-left cost and application start x=28,y=345, two regular sans rows about 17 px, 23 px step:
참가비 5,000원 · 재료 포함
신청 후 참여 · 정원 24명

Lower-right preparation and welcome start x=420,y=345, two regular sans rows about 17 px, 23 px step:
앞치마 지참
처음 해도 괜찮아요

Maintain crisp natural Hangul proportions, intact counters, unbroken strokes, meaningful word gaps and aligned baselines. Give the time-range en dash a recognizably longer horizontal form than a hyphen. Leave clear breathing room around all text; illustration never crosses letter strokes. The first glance should gather the sheet and attentive faces, the next should find the attendance group above left, and then follow the common lower fact baseline. Warm orange gathering mass and cool clear information ledges form one coherent composition.
